name: Neosol 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEOSOL 5MG TABLET

NEOSOL 5MG TABLET contains Trioxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatic agents. It is used in the management of vitiligo and psoriasis along with UV light.

Vitiligo is a pigmentation disorder of the skin that causes loss of skin colour in patches. Psoriasis is a skin condition that causes rashes with itchy, scaly spots on the knees, elbows, trunk, and scalp.

Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition. After taking the medicine avoid exposure to the sun even through a window or glass for at least 8 hours.

Before taking NEOSOL 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have or had an allergic reaction to sunlight, porphyria, heart or blood vessel disease, eye problems (cataract), infections, stomach pain, skin cancer or melanoma, and lupus erythematosus.

NEOSOL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. The safety and effectiveness of this medicine in breastfeeding women have not been established yet.

The safety and effectiveness of NEOSOL 5MG TABLET in elderly patients had not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking NEOSOL 5MG TABLET are itching, irritation and nausea. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEOSOL 5MG TABLET
Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How NEOSOL 5MG TABLET Works

NEOSOL 5MG TABLET works by activating certain skin cells (melanocytes) and helps repigment the discolored, white patches in vitiligo. It also slows down the rapid growth of skin cells in psoriasis. This reduces scaling and thickening of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use NEOSOL 5MG TABLET

Always take NEOSOL 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Cover your skin for at least 8 hours by wearing protective clothing, use a sunblock product that has a skin protection factor on your lips and on those areas of your body that cannot be covered. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

name: Logidruf S Solution 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About LOGIDRUF S LOTION

LOGIDRUF S LOTION is a combination of Coal tar, and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines known as Keratolytics and Keratoplastics respectively. It is used to manage conditions such as dandruff, psoriasis of scalp, psoriasis, neuro dermatitis, hyper keratotic skin conditions, keratoderma, seborrhaeic dermatitis and acne.

LOGIDRUF S LOTION is not recommended for use in infected, damaged or open skin, or blisters filled with pus (pustules). LOGIDRUF S LOTION should be used with caution in patients having broken or inflamed skin. LOGIDRUF S LOTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in breast-feeding woman.

LOGIDRUF S LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effects of this medicine are scalp irritation, skin conditions like acne and staining of cloth, skin, and hair. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LOGIDRUF S LOTION

It is used to manage:

Dandruff
Psoriasis of scalp
Psoriasis
Neuro dermatitis
Hyper keratotic skin conditions
Keratoderma
Seborrhaeic dermatitis
Acne
mechanismOfAction:
How LOGIDRUF S LOTION Works

LOGIDRUF S LOTION effectively reduces scalp conditions where Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which is increased in disease conditions) proliferation through inhibition of DNA which is necessary for the cell growth and multiplication. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.
usageDetails:
How to use LOGIDRUF S LOTION

Use LOGIDRUF S LOTION exactly as your doctor has told you. It is for external use only. Shake the bottle thoroughly before use. Wash your hands before and after use. Massage LOGIDRUF S LOTION in the wet scalp and rinse it. Apply and massage for 5minutes, rinse thoroughly with water. Avoid contact with eyes.

name: Derobin Ointment 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About DEROBIN OINTMENT

Derobin Ointment is a topical medicine used for the management of psoriasis and eczema. Also, it manages and relieves itching associated with its. It contains coal tar, dithranol and salicylic acid as key ingredients to manage psoriasis and eczema.   

Coal tar has antibacterial properties which manages the itchiness and promotes the softening of outer skin layer. Dithranol promotes healing of psoriatic lesions through immunosuppressive effects. Salicylic acid reduces the swelling and redness caused by the infection and acts as an antibacterial agent.   

Always use Derobin Ointment as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Apply the ointment to the affected areas of the skin preferably in the evening. While applying avoid contact from eyes and mucous membrane. Do not use this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

name: Salytar Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About SALYTAR OINTMENT

Salytar Ointment is an antiseptic ointment used to provide relief from skin itchiness, scaling and discomfort associated with skin conditions such as psoriasis, eczema, dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis. It contains Coal tar, Salicylic acid and Sulphur as active ingredients.

Coal tar, salicylic acid and sulfur are keratolytic agents. They remove dry, scaly dead cells from the skin surface, leading to skin peeling followed by the formation of fresh, newer skin cells. Additionally, sulfur can also destroy harmful bacteria, fungi or parasites that causes skin infections.

Use Salytar Ointment as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Gently apply Salytar Ointment on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this ointment with your eyes, ears, nose or mouth. In case of accidental contact, wash it immediately with water.

name: Aceret 25mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACERET 25MG CAPSULE

ACERET 25MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACERET 25MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

ACERET 25MG CAPSULE works by inhibiting the excessive cell growth and keratinization (process by which skin cells become thickened due to the deposition of a protein within them).

introduction:
Introduction About BELLISSA PSORIA SOAP

BELLISSA PSORIA Soap is formulated with fortified soap noodles derived from Palm and coconut oil. It contains a perfect blend of natural and synthetic ingredients which hydrates and moisturizes the skin. It soothes rough and dry skin, thereby making the skin clear, healthy, soft and supple. For best results, use BELLISSA PSORIA Soap as an adjuvant along with anti-psoriatic medicines.

The palm oil, coconut oil, shea butter and olive oil present in the soap forms a protective layer over your skin and manages skin dryness or scaling. The Aloe vera extract and omega-3-fatty acids present in the soap soothes skin irritation and makes your skin soft and supple. The permethrin present in the soap manages skin infections caused due to dry skin lesions and scaling.

Sprinkle water on BELLISSA PSORIA Soap and massage the soap between your hands to form lather. Gently apply the lather over the affected areas. Wash the lather liberally with water. Avoid contact of BELLISSA PSORIA Soap with your eyes. In case of accidental contact, wash it immediately with water.

name: Sorvate Ointment 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About SORVATE OINTMENT

SORVATE OINTMENT contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. SORVATE OINTMENT is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

SORVATE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying SORVATE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

[GBNKEYWORLD] should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women which is advised not to apply on breast area while feeding the baby.

SORVATE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged below 6 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SORVATE OINTMENT are pain at the site of application, burning/stinging sensation, skin irritation, itching, itchy rash, and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Sternon S Lotion 32ml
introduction:
Introduction About STERNON S LOTION

STERNON S LOTION is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used to manage subacute and chronic hyperkeratotic and dry skin diseases which respond to external topical steroid therapy. These conditions include psoriasis, keratosis palmaris et plantaris (keratinisation of the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot), chronic eczema or allergic skin diseases, endogenous eczema/atopic dermatitis, seborrhoeic eczema, dyshidrosis lemellosa sicca (itching, dry, squamous vesicles on palms of the hand, sides of fingers or foot-soles), lichen planus, lichen simplex and ichthyosis.

Before using STERNON S LOTION your doctor may want to check your management regularly if you have a skin condition called psoriasis, or if you are having any raised bumps filled with pus under your skin. You are not recommended to smoke or go near naked flames while using STERNON S LOTION as it may cause serious fire hazards. STERNON S LOTION during pregnancy and lactation should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the foetus. Consult your doctor before using.

STERNON S LOTION is not recommended in children under 1 year of age. Consult your doctor before using. It should be used with caution in elderly people. The common side effects of using STERNON S LOTION are pruritus, local skin burning and skin pain. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bothers or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How STERNON S LOTION Works

STERNON S LOTION is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid. Betamethasone works by blocking the production of certain inflammatory mediators called prostaglandins in the body and thus reduces the redness and swelling. It has anti-inflammatory proteins which are responsible for removing the scaly layers of the skin and reduces the redness and itchiness caused by the various skin problems. Salicylic acid manages the skin lesions by peeling the outer layer of the skin and helps to re-establish the normal skin by removing the dead skin. It also promotes the fast absorption of betamethasone into the skin.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: Melanocyl Ointment 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About MELANOCYL OINTMENT

MELANOCYL OINTMENT contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis. In psoriasis, the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. In vitiligo, pale white patches develop on the skin, commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases, due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

MELANOCYL OINTMENT can also be used to manage cutaneous T cell lymphoma (certain white blood cells become cancerous and affect the skin, causing different types of skin lesions), lichen planus (inflammation of skin and mucous membranes), alopecia totalis (complete hair loss of the scalp), photodermatitis (dermatitis caused due to light sensitivity), cutaneous mastocytosis (gathering of excessive number of mast cells in the skin) and atopic dermatitis (itchy skin inflammation).

MELANOCYL OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, and photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum). Avoid exposure to the sun as it may lead to a high risk of burning.

Before using MELANOCYL OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma or a history of basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic therapy, previous x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

MELANOCYL OINTMENT should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the duration of therapy. Contact your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects or if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How MELANOCYL OINTMENT Works

MELANOCYL OINTMENT works by increasing skin reactivity to UV rays, bonds covalently to DNA and inhibits DNA synthesis, thus suppressing excessive cell division and the time taken for the epidermis (outermost skin layer) to replace itself.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTOID 25MG CAPSULE

ACTOID 25MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACTOID 25MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

introduction:
Introduction About SALEN CAPSULE

SALEN CAPSULE contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis.

Psoriasis is a condition in which the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Vitiligo is a long-term condition in which pale white patches develop on any area of skin (commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases) due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

During SALEN CAPSULE management, your doctor may advise you to wear special wrap-around sunglasses that totally block or absorb ultraviolet light, to avoid exposure of your skin and lips to sunlight for 8 hours after management, to wear protective clothing like hat or gloves to cover as much of your body as possible after management, and to use a sunscreen product having a protection factor of at least 15 (only after management).

SALEN CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, or photosensitivity diseases.

Before taking SALEN CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic, x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

SALEN CAPSULE should be taken in pregnancy only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the therapy. Breastfeeding should be avoided while taking SALEN CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking SALEN CAPSULE are itching, redness of the skin, and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SALEN CAPSULE

It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light to manage:

Vitiligo
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How SALEN CAPSULE Works

In psoriasis, SALEN CAPSULE is assumed to work by damaging the DNA on exposure to light, resulting in decreased cell multiplication, but other mechanisms may also be playing some role. In vitiligo, it has been suggested that melanocytes (cells containing the pigment called melanin) in the hair follicle are stimulated by SALEN CAPSULE to move up the follicle and to repopulate the outermost layer of your skin.
usageDetails:
How to use SALEN CAPSULE

Take SALEN CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide an appropriate dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

brand: KAIZEN RESEARCH LABS INDIA PVT LTD
introduction:
Introduction About TARRY SHINE LOTION

Tarry Shine Lotion is a keratolytic and antifungal preparation for topical application, used to manage itching and flaking caused by dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis and psoriasis of the scalp. It contains coal tar and ketoconazole as an active ingredient which removes the dead skin cells and kills the fungus.

Coal tar is a keratoplastic agent, which removes dead skin cells and slows down the growth of the outer layer of skin cells on the scalp. Thus, relieves itching and removes dry, scaly particles. Ketoconazole is an antifungal agent, which works by managing the growth of fungi causing the infection.

Always use Tarry Shine Lotion as directed by a physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If this happens rinse the eyes with water. Wet your hair, gently massage Tarry Shine Lotion onto your scalp and keep it for 5 minutes and then rinse with water.

name: Pasitrex C Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About PASITREX C OINTMENT

PASITREX C OINTMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

PASITREX C OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

PASITREX C OINTMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply PASITREX C OINTMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using PASITREX C OINTMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. PASITREX C OINTMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of PASITREX C OINTMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PASITREX C OINTMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How PASITREX C OINTMENT Works

PASITREX C OINTMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.
usageDetails:
How to use PASITREX C OINTMENT

Apply PASITREX C OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

Have ulcers, wounds
Have itching in the genitals

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using.

PASITREX C OINTMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

name: Salen Solution 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALEN SOLUTION

SALEN SOLUTION contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis. In psoriasis, the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. In vitiligo, pale white patches develop on the skin, commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases, due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

SALEN SOLUTION can also be used to manage cutaneous T cell lymphoma (certain white blood cells become cancerous and affect the skin, causing different types of skin lesions), lichen planus (inflammation of skin and mucous membranes), alopecia totalis (complete hair loss of the scalp), photodermatitis (dermatitis caused due to light sensitivity), cutaneous mastocytosis (gathering of excessive number of mast cells in the skin) and atopic dermatitis (itchy skin inflammation).

SALEN SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, and photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum). Avoid exposure to the sun as it may lead to a high risk of burning.

Before using SALEN SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma or a history of basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic therapy, previous x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

SALEN SOLUTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the duration of therapy. Contact your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects or if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SALEN SOLUTION

It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light to manage certain skin diseases like:

Vitiligo
Psoriasis
Cutaneous T cell lymphoma
Lichen planus
Alopecia totalis
Photodermatitis
Cutaneous mastocytosis
Atopic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How SALEN SOLUTION Works

SALEN SOLUTION works by increasing skin reactivity to UV rays, bonds covalently to DNA and inhibits DNA synthesis, thus suppressing excessive cell division and the time taken for the epidermis (outermost skin layer) to replace itself.
usageDetails:
How to use SALEN SOLUTION

Apply SALEN SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Increased risk of malignant cutaneous neoplasms (cancerous tumors of the skin)

introduction:
Introduction About APREZO 20 TABLET

APREZO 20 TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APREZO 20 TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APREZO 20 TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APREZO 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APREZO 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APREZO 20 TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APREZO 20 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APREZO 20 TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About OCTAMOP LOTION

OCTAMOP LOTION contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis. In psoriasis, the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. In vitiligo, pale white patches develop on the skin, commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases, due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

OCTAMOP LOTION can also be used to manage cutaneous T cell lymphoma (certain white blood cells become cancerous and affect the skin, causing different types of skin lesions), lichen planus (inflammation of skin and mucous membranes), alopecia totalis (complete hair loss of the scalp), photodermatitis (dermatitis caused due to light sensitivity), cutaneous mastocytosis (gathering of excessive number of mast cells in the skin) and atopic dermatitis (itchy skin inflammation).

OCTAMOP LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, and photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum). Avoid exposure to the sun as it may lead to a high risk of burning.

Before using OCTAMOP LOTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma or a history of basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic therapy, previous x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

OCTAMOP LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the duration of therapy. Contact your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects or if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How OCTAMOP LOTION Works

OCTAMOP LOTION works by increasing skin reactivity to UV rays, bonds covalently to DNA and inhibits DNA synthesis, thus suppressing excessive cell division and the time taken for the epidermis (outermost skin layer) to replace itself.

Apply OCTAMOP LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About APREZO 30MG TABLET

APREZO 30MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APREZO 30MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APREZO 30MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APREZO 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APREZO 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APREZO 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APREZO 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APREZO 30MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIMOP TABLET

TRIMOP TABLET contains Trioxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatic agents. It is used in the management of vitiligo and psoriasis along with UV light.

Vitiligo is a pigmentation disorder of the skin that causes loss of skin colour in patches. Psoriasis is a skin condition that causes rashes with itchy, scaly spots on the knees, elbows, trunk, and scalp.

Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition. After taking the medicine avoid exposure to the sun even through a window or glass for at least 8 hours.

Before taking TRIMOP TABLET inform your doctor if you have or had an allergic reaction to sunlight, porphyria, heart or blood vessel disease, eye problems (cataract), infections, stomach pain, skin cancer or melanoma, and lupus erythematosus.

TRIMOP TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. The safety and effectiveness of this medicine in breastfeeding women have not been established yet.

The safety and effectiveness of TRIMOP TABLET in elderly patients had not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking TRIMOP TABLET are itching, irritation and nausea. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIMOP TABLET
Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIMOP TABLET Works

TRIMOP TABLET works by activating certain skin cells (melanocytes) and helps repigment the discolored, white patches in vitiligo. It also slows down the rapid growth of skin cells in psoriasis. This reduces scaling and thickening of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIMOP TABLET

Always take TRIMOP TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Cover your skin for at least 8 hours by wearing protective clothing, use a sunblock product that has a skin protection factor on your lips and on those areas of your body that cannot be covered. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

name: TOPISAL 6% Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About TOPISAL 6% LOTION

TOPISAL 6% LOTION is a combination of Clobetasol propionate and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents, respectively. TOPISAL 6% LOTION is used to manage and provide relief from inflammatory manifestations of skin conditions such as psoriasis (skin condition marked by rash and itchiness), and eczema (skin inflammation) in affected individuals. TOPISAL 6% LOTION is also used to provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions. It is also indicated for use to manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses (skin lesion), seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and/or ichthyosis vulgaris (inherited skin condition marked by dry & scaly skin) in affected individuals.

TOPISAL 6% LOTION is generally not recommended for use in patients allergic to Clobetasol, and/or Salicylic acid. TOPISAL 6% LOTION is advised to be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. TOPISAL 6% LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects associated with the use of TOPISAL 6% LOTION are irritation, burning, redness, and/or stinging sensation (at the site of application), skin rash, itching, and/or peeling/ thinning of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage and provide relief from inflammatory manifestations of skin conditions such as psoriasis and eczema
Provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions
Manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses, seborrheic dermatitis of scalp, and/or ichthyosis vulgaris in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOPISAL 6% LOTION

It is used to:

Provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions

mechanismOfAction:
How TOPISAL 6% LOTION Works

TOPISAL 6% LOTION provides relief from psoriasis and eczema, where Clobetasol propionate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and/or itchy. Salicylic acid softens the skin by removing dead skin cells and breaking down keratin clumps which results in reducing itchiness and redness of skin, thus providing relief from psoriasis and eczema in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use TOPISAL 6% LOTION

Always apply TOPISAL 6% LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands and apply a thin layer of medicine on the affected area. Avoid covering the affected area with airtight dressings unless recommended. Avoid applying the medicine on face, groin, or axillae. Your doctor will decide the correct dose. and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Salytar Solution 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALYTAR SOLUTION

Salytar Solution is a scalp lotion which is used in the management itching and flaking associated with conditions like psoriasis, seborrheic dermatitis and dandruff of the scalp. It contains Coal tar and Salicylic acid as active ingredients which helps in removal of dead skin cells.

Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which increases in diseased conditions) proliferation and slow down the growth of skin cells. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.

Always use Salytar Solution as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Take a small quantity of this lotion. Wet your hair, apply and massage the lotion in the wet scalp. Rinse and re-apply allowing the lather to sit for 5 minutes and rinse it with water. Do not use soap or shampoo before or after using this lotion. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SALYTAR SOLUTION

Salytar Solution may cause scalp irritation and staining of skin or hair. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this lotion.

introduction:
Introduction About PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION

PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION is a combination of Coal tar, and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines known as Keratolytics and Keratoplastics respectively. It is used to manage conditions such as dandruff, psoriasis of scalp, psoriasis, neuro dermatitis, hyper keratotic skin conditions, keratoderma, seborrhaeic dermatitis and acne.

PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infected, damaged or open skin, or blisters filled with pus (pustules). PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION should be used with caution in patients having broken or inflamed skin. PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in breast-feeding woman.

PROTAR SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effects of this medicine are scalp irritation, skin conditions like acne and staining of cloth, skin, and hair. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About EXSORA OINTMENT

EXSORA OINTMENT is a combination of Benzoic Acid, Ichthammol, Salicylic Acid and Triamcinolone Acetonide which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical antifungals, Keratolytic and topical corticosteroids respectively. It is a topical ointment used to manage chronic eczematous dermatoses and psoriasis.

EXSORA OINTMENT also reduces inflammation quickly, relieves irritation, ensures psoriasis recovery, helps in the rebuilding of normal, healthy skin, and is used on hard plaques on the soles and palms.

Things to be avoided while using EXSORA OINTMENT are placing wet or wet-to-dry packs on the affected areas, applying additional drugs to the same area of skin, applying in broken areas, and smoking, which may lead to a fire.

EXSORA OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. EXSORA OINTMENT is not recommended for breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. EXSORA OINTMENT should be used with caution around children. EXSORA OINTMENT should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking EXSORA OINTMENT are a warm or burning sensation, irritations or allergic skin reactions, skin redness, itching, excessive dryness, peeling, thinning of your skin, blistering skin, stretch marks, and acne. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Manage fissured feet (divides in skin over the heels)
Manage cracked heals (cracks in skin over the heels)
Manage chronic dermatitis (itchy & inflammation of skin)

mechanismOfAction:
How EXSORA OINTMENT Works

Benzoic Acid has fungistatic properties which stops the growth of bacteria, Ichthammol has anti-inflammatory, antiparasitic and keratolytic action which relieves itching as well as the severe skin thickening and stiffness, also has mild inhibition of bacterial growth.

Both ichthammol and salicylic acid act as keratolytics by causing the protein keratin (which makes up most of the outer skin structure) to soften. This helps remove dry, scaly skin easily by helping to loosen it.

Triamcinolone acetonide acts as an anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressant, works as a potent inhibitor of inflammatory cells, and reduces the expression of inflammatory mediators.

Always apply EXSORA OINTMENT as directed by your physician. Wash your hands before and after use. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area 3 or 4 times a day. The medication should not be administered through the mouth, nose, or eyes. Rinse with water if it enters any of these places. Depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition, your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you.

introduction:
Introduction About BETNOVATE S OINTMENT

BETNOVATE S OINTMENT is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used to manage subacute and chronic hyperkeratotic and dry skin diseases which respond to external topical steroid therapy. These conditions include psoriasis, keratosis palmaris et plantaris (keratinisation of the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot), chronic eczema or allergic skin diseases, endogenous eczema/atopic dermatitis, seborrhoeic eczema, dyshidrosis lemellosa sicca (itching, dry, squamous vesicles on palms of the hand, sides of fingers or foot-soles), lichen planus, lichen simplex and ichthyosis.

Before using BETNOVATE S OINTMENT your doctor may want to check your management regularly if you have a skin condition called psoriasis, or if you are having any raised bumps filled with pus under your skin. You are not recommended to smoke or go near naked flames while using BETNOVATE S OINTMENT as it may cause serious fire hazards. BETNOVATE S OINTMENT during pregnancy and lactation should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the foetus. Consult your doctor before using.

BETNOVATE S OINTMENT is not recommended in children under 1 year of age. Consult your doctor before using. It should be used with caution in elderly people. mechanismOfAction:
How BETNOVATE S OINTMENT Works

BETNOVATE S OINTMENT is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid. Betamethasone works by blocking the production of certain inflammatory mediators called prostaglandins in the body and thus reduces the redness and swelling. It has anti-inflammatory proteins which are responsible for removing the scaly layers of the skin and reduces the redness and itchiness caused by the various skin problems. Salicylic acid manages the skin lesions by peeling the outer layer of the skin and helps to re-establish the normal skin by removing the dead skin. It also promotes the fast absorption of betamethasone into the skin.

Apply BETNOVATE S OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: Acrotac 25mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACROTAC 25MG CAPSULE

ACROTAC 25MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACROTAC 25MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

name: Tarich Scalp Solution 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is a combination of Coal tar, and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines known as Keratolytics and Keratoplastics respectively. It is used to manage conditions such as dandruff, psoriasis of scalp, psoriasis, neuro dermatitis, hyper keratotic skin conditions, keratoderma, seborrhaeic dermatitis and acne.

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infected, damaged or open skin, or blisters filled with pus (pustules). TARICH SCALP SOLUTION should be used with caution in patients having broken or inflamed skin. TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in breast-feeding woman.

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effects of this medicine are scalp irritation, skin conditions like acne and staining of cloth, skin, and hair. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

It is used to manage:

Dandruff
Psoriasis of scalp
Psoriasis
Neuro dermatitis
Hyper keratotic skin conditions
Keratoderma
Seborrhaeic dermatitis
Acne
mechanismOfAction:
How TARICH SCALP SOLUTION Works

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION effectively reduces scalp conditions where Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which is increased in disease conditions) proliferation through inhibition of DNA which is necessary for the cell growth and multiplication. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.
usageDetails:
How to use TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

Use TARICH SCALP SOLUTION exactly as your doctor has told you. It is for external use only. Shake the bottle thoroughly before use. Wash your hands before and after use. Massage TARICH SCALP SOLUTION in the wet scalp and rinse it. Apply and massage for 5minutes, rinse thoroughly with water. Avoid contact with eyes.

name: TAR 18 Shampoo 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About TAR 18 SHAMPOO

TAR 18 SHAMPOO contains Coal tar which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agent. It is used to control the symptoms such as itching, scaling, flaking, redness and irritation of skin caused by scalp psoriasis (a skin condition that cause thick crusted plaques over the scalp), seborrheic dermatitis (red scaly patches on the scalp) and dandruff (bran-like scaly patches scattered within hair-bearing areas of the scalp) in adults and children aged 12 years and above.

TAR 18 SHAMPOO is not recommended for use if you have inflamed or broken skin, erythrodermic or pustular psoriasis (redness, inflammation and blistering of the skin). Consult your doctor before using it.

TAR 18 SHAMPOO is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. TAR 18 SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAR 18 SHAMPOO

To control the symptoms of:

Scalp psoriasis
Seborrheic dermatitis
Dandruff
mechanismOfAction:
How TAR 18 SHAMPOO Works

TAR 18 SHAMPOO works by slowing excessive skin cell production. Thus, helps to control psoriasis. It has also cellular proliferation-inhibiting, vasoconstrictive, antipruritic (anti-itching) and antiseptic properties, which is important in the management of seborrheic dermatitis and dandruff.
usageDetails:
How to use TAR 18 SHAMPOO

Apply TAR 18 SHAMPOO as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet the hair thoroughly. Apply and massage TAR 18 SHAMPOO into the scalp to form a rich lather. Leave the lather on the scalp for several minutes and then rinse off with water. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not apply to genital and rectal area.

Rare

name: Denidol Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About DENIDOL LOTION

DENIDOL LOTION contains Desonide which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. DENIDOL LOTION is used to relieve inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatosis.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take a urinary-free cortisol and ACTH (adrenocorticotropic hormone) stimulation test to evaluate HPA axis suppression (a condition that causes poor body defence against infection) especially in children to manage its effect in the body.

Before applying DENIDOL LOTION, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Desonide or any other ingredients in the medicine, and or have concomitant skin infections (infections caused by parasites).

DENIDOL LOTION should be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is necessary. Consult your doctor for advice.

DENIDOL LOTION is not recommended for use in children (less than 2 years of age). Consult your doctor before applying DENIDOL LOTION.

The most common side effects of applying DENIDOL LOTION are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching and redness, headache. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Used to relieve inflammatory and pruritic manifestation of corticosteroid-responsive dermatosis
usesDetails:
Uses Of DENIDOL LOTION
Used to relieve inflammatory and pruritic manifestation of corticosteroid-responsive dermatosis
mechanismOfAction:
How DENIDOL LOTION Works

DENIDOL LOTION works by the induction of lipocortins (inflammatory enzyme) that results in the decreased biosynthesis of prostaglandins and leukotrienes (potent mediators of inflammation) which manages the release of arachidonic acid (hormone responsible for inflammatory process in the skin) thus providing relief from the inflammation, redness, and itching sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DENIDOL LOTION

Apply DENIDOL LOTION as directed by your doctor. It is for external use only. Avoid contact of this medicine in your eyes, ears, nose, mouth, or mucous membrane. Your doctor will decide the duration of management depending on the severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About APRAIZE 10MG TABLET

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APRAIZE 10MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APRAIZE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APRAIZE 10MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

How APRAIZE 10MG TABLET Works

APRAIZE 10MG TABLET works by reducing the activity of phosphodiesterase 4 (enzyme involved in the process of inflammation) which leads to reduced occurrence of inflammatory process and providing relief from signs & symptoms associated with conditions such as psoriatic arthritis, chronic plaque psoriasis and Behcet’s disease in affected individuals.

Take APRAIZE 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Calpsor C Lotion 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About CALPSOR C LOTION

CALPSOR C LOTION is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

CALPSOR C LOTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

CALPSOR C LOTION is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply CALPSOR C LOTION on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using CALPSOR C LOTION. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. CALPSOR C LOTION should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of CALPSOR C LOTION are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALPSOR C LOTION
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How CALPSOR C LOTION Works

CALPSOR C LOTION works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.
usageDetails:
How to use CALPSOR C LOTION

Apply CALPSOR C LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

Common
Skin irritation
Mild aggravation of psoriasis

Introduction About CALPSOR LOTION

CALPSOR LOTION contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. CALPSOR LOTION is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

CALPSOR LOTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying CALPSOR LOTION, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

name: Melanocyl Tablet 40'S
introduction:
Introduction About MELANOCYL TABLET

MELANOCYL TABLET contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis.

Psoriasis is a condition in which the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Vitiligo is a long-term condition in which pale white patches develop on any area of skin (commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases) due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

During MELANOCYL TABLET management, your doctor may advise you to wear special wrap-around sunglasses that totally block or absorb ultraviolet light, to avoid exposure of your skin and lips to sunlight for 8 hours after management, to wear protective clothing like hat or gloves to cover as much of your body as possible after management, and to use a sunscreen product having a protection factor of at least 15 (only after management).

MELANOCYL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, or photosensitivity diseases.

Before taking MELANOCYL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic, x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

MELANOCYL TABLET should be taken in pregnancy only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the therapy. Breastfeeding should be avoided while taking MELANOCYL TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking MELANOCYL TABLET are itching, redness of the skin, and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MELANOCYL TABLET

It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light to manage:

Vitiligo
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How MELANOCYL TABLET Works

In psoriasis, MELANOCYL TABLET is assumed to work by damaging the DNA on exposure to light, resulting in decreased cell multiplication, but other mechanisms may also be playing some role. In vitiligo, it has been suggested that melanocytes (cells containing the pigment called melanin) in the hair follicle are stimulated by MELANOCYL TABLET to move up the follicle and to repopulate the outermost layer of your skin.
usageDetails:
How to use MELANOCYL TABLET

Take MELANOCYL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide an appropriate dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

MELANOCYL TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your physician before taking it.
Do not take MELANOCYL TABLET if you are allergic to Methoxsalen or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
MELANOCYL TABLET should be used with caution in patients having heart or blood pressure problems. Consult your physician before taking it.

Others

MELANOCYL TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye)
Have or had melanoma
Have invasive squamous cell carcinoma
Have photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum, erythropoietic protoporphyria, variegate porphyria, and albinism)

Before taking MELANOCYL TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had multiple basal cell carcinoma
Had arsenic therapy
Recently had x-ray or Grenz ray therapy or are about to have one
Are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress
Have GI diseases
Have chronic infection
Have or had any eye problems like cataracts or loss of the lens of the eyes
Have any medical condition that requires you to stay out of the sun like lupus erythematosus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety of MELANOCYL TABLET in children has not been established so, consult your child's doctor for advice.

Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. griseofulvin, itraconazole)
Medicines used in psychiatric disorders (Ex. chlorpromazine, fluphenazine)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. nalidixic acid, sulfonamides, tetracyclines, ofloxacin, moxifloxacin)
Medicines used to manage parasitic infections (Ex. closantel, niclosamide)
Medicines used to manage fluid retention (Ex. chlorthalidone, hydrochlorothiazide)

Avoid psoralen-containing foods (Ex. parsley, parsnip, celery) while taking MELANOCYL TABLET as it may increase the risk of phototoxicity.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MELANOCYL TABLET, make them stay out of sunlight and consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:

Atarax Anti Itch Lotion is an advanced formula with fast action, maintains neutral pH, retains moisture and skin integrity. It provides immediate relief from itch in various conditions such as scabies, eczema, sunburn, an allergic rash, insect bites and tinea infection. It contains aloe vera gel, promoxine, glycerine and calamine as an active ingredient which is used to provide relief from itchy and dry skin.      

Aloe vera keeps skin hydrated. Light liquid paraffin and propylene glycol work by soothing, moisturising and conditioning your skin and stops loss of moisture from your skin. Glycerin provides a moisturising effect on the skin. Calamine provides cooling relief from skin irritation. Pramoxine reduces itching within 2-3mins after applying. Methyl paraben and propyl paraben has antimicrobial property. Tetrahydrocurcumin is a skin whitening agent, wound management, cosmetic application and manages various skin-related disorders.       

Always use Atarax Anti Itch Lotion as directed by the physician. For external use only. Shake well before use. Apply a thin layer of the lotion on the affected area by gently massaging, until it is absorbed. Apply 2-3 times a day. Avoid applying Atarax Anti Itch lotion on punctured wounds, infected or bruised skin. Avoid contact with eyes. If condition does not improve in seven days, discontinue usage of the lotion and consult your doctor immediately.

name: Melanocyl Solution 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About MELANOCYL SOLUTION

MELANOCYL SOLUTION contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis. In psoriasis, the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. In vitiligo, pale white patches develop on the skin, commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases, due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

MELANOCYL SOLUTION can also be used to manage cutaneous T cell lymphoma (certain white blood cells become cancerous and affect the skin, causing different types of skin lesions), lichen planus (inflammation of skin and mucous membranes), alopecia totalis (complete hair loss of the scalp), photodermatitis (dermatitis caused due to light sensitivity), cutaneous mastocytosis (gathering of excessive number of mast cells in the skin) and atopic dermatitis (itchy skin inflammation).

MELANOCYL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, and photosensitivity diseases (Ex. porphyria, acute lupus erythematosus, xeroderma pigmentosum). Avoid exposure to the sun as it may lead to a high risk of burning.

Before using MELANOCYL SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma or a history of basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic therapy, previous x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

MELANOCYL SOLUTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the duration of therapy. Contact your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects or if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MELANOCYL SOLUTION

mechanismOfAction:
How MELANOCYL SOLUTION Works

MELANOCYL SOLUTION works by increasing skin reactivity to UV rays, bonds covalently to DNA and inhibits DNA synthesis, thus suppressing excessive cell division and the time taken for the epidermis (outermost skin layer) to replace itself.

Apply MELANOCYL SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Actoid 10mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACTOID 10MG CAPSULE

ACTOID 10MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACTOID 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

name: APXENTA 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About APXENTA 10MG TABLET

APXENTA 10MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APXENTA 10MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APXENTA 10MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APXENTA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APXENTA 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APXENTA 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APXENTA 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APXENTA 10MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

APXENTA 10MG TABLET works by reducing the activity of phosphodiesterase 4 (enzyme involved in the process of inflammation) which leads to reduced occurrence of inflammatory process and providing relief from signs & symptoms associated with conditions such as psoriatic arthritis, chronic plaque psoriasis and Behcet’s disease in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About ASCABIOL EMULSION

ASCABIOL EMULSION contains Cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride, which belong to the group of medicines called Antiseptics and Antiparasitic drugs, respectively. It is used for the management of scabies (skin infection with itchy skin rashes caused by mites), pediculosis (infestation of scalp caused by eggs, larvae, or adults of lice), and lice.

It is advised to avoid person-to-person contact and sharing of clothes and utensils with infected persons to avoid the risk of spreading of scabies and lice. It is not recommended to use ASCABIOL EMULSION if you have fits, allergies to any of its ingredients, open, broken, or cranky skin. Before using ASCABIOL EMULSION, inform your doctor if you have HIV or AIDS, have a history of fits or conditions like a head injury, tumour in your brain or spinal cord, cirrhosis of the liver, or are heavy alcohol drinkers.

ASCABIOL EMULSION is not recommended to be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless it is clearly necessary. Do not use ASCABIOL EMULSION to manage a premature infant, young baby, or elderly patient. The most common side effects of using ASCABIOL EMULSION include tingling, itching, burning in the skin, and skin rashes. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ASCABIOL EMULSION Works

ASCABIOL EMULSION contains cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride. Cetrimide is an antiseptic agent that kills disease-causing bacteria. Gamma benzene hexachloride is an insecticide that kills insects by damaging the brains of mites.
usageDetails:
How to use ASCABIOL EMULSION

Apply ASCABIOL EMULSION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Wash your hands before applying ASCABIOL EMULSION. Take adequate amounts of medicine and apply on affected areas (apply on the entire body in cases of scabies). Wash off completely with warm water after 8–12 hours.

Read the instructions within the label before using the medicine. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, and mouth. Avoid making your skin too oily by applying creams while using ASCABIOL EMULSION. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is a combination of Coal tar, and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines known as Keratolytics and Keratoplastics respectively. It is used to manage conditions such as dandruff, psoriasis of scalp, psoriasis, neuro dermatitis, hyper keratotic skin conditions, keratoderma, seborrhaeic dermatitis and acne.

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infected, damaged or open skin, or blisters filled with pus (pustules). TARICH SCALP SOLUTION should be used with caution in patients having broken or inflamed skin. TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in breast-feeding woman.

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effects of this medicine are scalp irritation, skin conditions like acne and staining of cloth, skin, and hair. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

It is used to manage:

Dandruff
Psoriasis of scalp
Psoriasis
Neuro dermatitis
Hyper keratotic skin conditions
Keratoderma

Acne
mechanismOfAction:
How TARICH SCALP SOLUTION Works

TARICH SCALP SOLUTION effectively reduces scalp conditions where Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which is increased in disease conditions) proliferation through inhibition of DNA which is necessary for the cell growth and multiplication. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.
usageDetails:
How to use TARICH SCALP SOLUTION

Use TARICH SCALP SOLUTION exactly as your doctor has told you. It is for external use only. Shake the bottle thoroughly before use. Wash your hands before and after use. Massage TARICH SCALP SOLUTION in the wet scalp and rinse it. Apply and massage for 5minutes, rinse thoroughly with water. Avoid contact with eyes.

introduction:
Introduction About CALPSOR OINTMENT

CALPSOR OINTMENT contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. CALPSOR OINTMENT is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

CALPSOR OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying CALPSOR OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

[GBNKEYWORLD] should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women which is advised not to apply on breast area while feeding the baby.

CALPSOR OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged below 6 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying CALPSOR OINTMENT are pain at the site of application, burning/stinging sensation, skin irritation, itching, itchy rash, and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

CALPSOR OINTMENT works by inhibiting cell growth and its development without causing any harm to the cell which results in decreased growth of abnormal cells thus controlling psoriatic condition and managing the condition in affected individuals.

Always apply CALPSOR OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not use this medicine on your face.

introduction:
Introduction About APRAIZE 30MG TABLET

APRAIZE 30MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APRAIZE 30MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APRAIZE 30MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APRAIZE 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APRAIZE 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APRAIZE 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APRAIZE 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APRAIZE 30MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
