introduction:
Introduction About BENOQUIN CREAM

BENOQUIN CREAM contains Monobenzone which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting Agents. BENOQUIN CREAM is used to manage uneven appearance of skin (loss of skin colour) caused by vitiligo, which is a skin condition that occurs due to loss of brown colour (pigment) in skin resulting in white patches (on skin) in affected individuals.  

BENOQUIN CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Monobenzone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hyper-pigmentation (darkened patches/spots on the skin due to other pigments), skin discoloration pigments (such as sunspots, age spots, freckles), and/or skin trauma.

BENOQUIN CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 12 to 18 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying BENOQUIN CREAM are skin irritation, and allergic contact dermatitis (skin rash). Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How BENOQUIN CREAM Works

BENOQUIN CREAM works by decreasing the amount of melanin (skin darkening pigment) from skin cells which results in uniformity of skin colour in affected individuals thus managing loss of skin colour due to vitiligo.

introduction:
Introduction About SORETIN 25MG CAPSULE

SORETIN 25MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take SORETIN 25MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

name: CALPSOR C Ointment 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CALPSOR C OINTMENT

CALPSOR C OINTMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

CALPSOR C OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

CALPSOR C OINTMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply CALPSOR C OINTMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using CALPSOR C OINTMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. CALPSOR C OINTMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of CALPSOR C OINTMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALPSOR C OINTMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How CALPSOR C OINTMENT Works

CALPSOR C OINTMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.
usageDetails:
How to use CALPSOR C OINTMENT

Apply CALPSOR C OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: APREZO 10 Tablet 4's
introduction:
Introduction About APREZO 10 TABLET

APREZO 10 TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APREZO 10 TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APREZO 10 TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APREZO 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APREZO 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APREZO 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APREZO 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APREZO 10 TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

APREZO 10 TABLET works by reducing the activity of phosphodiesterase 4 (enzyme involved in the process of inflammation) which leads to reduced occurrence of inflammatory process and providing relief from signs & symptoms associated with conditions such as psoriatic arthritis, chronic plaque psoriasis and Behcet’s disease in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About ALIZAP 30MG TABLET

ALIZAP 30MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. ALIZAP 30MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

ALIZAP 30MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

ALIZAP 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking ALIZAP 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

ALIZAP 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

ALIZAP 30MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ALIZAP 30MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About METASONE F CREAM

METASONE F CREAM is a combination of Fusidic acid and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents and Corticosteroids, respectively. METASONE F CREAM is used to manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals.

METASONE F CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Fusidic acid, Mometasone, and/or other topical/oral corticosteroids. Before applying METASONE F CREAM, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, glaucoma, infection at/near management site, active viral illnesses (such as chicken pox / measles), and/or suffer from liver failure.

[GBNKEYWORD is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying METASONE F CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning/stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (inflamed hair follicles), dry skin, mild skin atrophy, and/or telangiectasia (dilated small blood vessels on skin). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How METASONE F CREAM Works

METASONE F CREAM manages inflammatory dermatoses, where mometasone furoate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy, and fusidic acid manages the growth of bacteria and causes its destruction by inhibiting the synthesis of essential proteins that are essential for the bacteria to grow thus managing inflammatory dermatoses in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About BETASALIC OINTMENT

BETASALIC OINTMENT is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used to manage subacute and chronic hyperkeratotic and dry skin diseases which respond to external topical steroid therapy. These conditions include psoriasis, keratosis palmaris et plantaris (keratinisation of the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot), chronic eczema or allergic skin diseases, endogenous eczema/atopic dermatitis, seborrhoeic eczema, dyshidrosis lemellosa sicca (itching, dry, squamous vesicles on palms of the hand, sides of fingers or foot-soles), lichen planus, lichen simplex and ichthyosis.

Before using BETASALIC OINTMENT your doctor may want to check your management regularly if you have a skin condition called psoriasis, or if you are having any raised bumps filled with pus under your skin. You are not recommended to smoke or go near naked flames while using BETASALIC OINTMENT as it may cause serious fire hazards. BETASALIC OINTMENT during pregnancy and lactation should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the foetus. Consult your doctor before using.

BETASALIC OINTMENT is not recommended in children under 1 year of age. Consult your doctor before using. It should be used with caution in elderly people. The common side effects of using BETASALIC OINTMENT are pruritus, local skin burning and skin pain. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bothers or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How BETASALIC OINTMENT Works

BETASALIC OINTMENT is a combination of Betamethasone and Salicylic acid. Betamethasone works by blocking the production of certain inflammatory mediators called prostaglandins in the body and thus reduces the redness and swelling. It has anti-inflammatory proteins which are responsible for removing the scaly layers of the skin and reduces the redness and itchiness caused by the various skin problems. Salicylic acid manages the skin lesions by peeling the outer layer of the skin and helps to re-establish the normal skin by removing the dead skin. It also promotes the fast absorption of betamethasone into the skin.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: Sorifix Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About SORIFIX OINTMENT

SORIFIX OINTMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

SORIFIX OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

SORIFIX OINTMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply SORIFIX OINTMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using SORIFIX OINTMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. SORIFIX OINTMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of SORIFIX OINTMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SORIFIX OINTMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How SORIFIX OINTMENT Works

SORIFIX OINTMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.

introduction:
Introduction About APRAIZE 20MG TABLET

APRAIZE 20MG TABLET contains Apremilast which belongs to a group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitors. APRAIZE 20MG TABLET is used to manage active psoriatic arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of joints) in adults when disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (medications used to manage arthritis) are insufficient to manage the disease.

APRAIZE 20MG TABLET is also used to manage moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (chronic inflammatory skin disease) when phototherapy (management with a special type of light), and/or systemic therapy (with ciclosporin, methotrexate, psoralen) are insufficient to manage the disease. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage Behçet’s disease (rare inflammatory disorder that affects blood vessels and tissues) in adults.

APRAIZE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Apremilast. Before taking APRAIZE 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are underweight, and/or have gut problems, intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as severe kidney disease), and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

APRAIZE 20MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine passes through breastmilk.

APRAIZE 20MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking APRAIZE 20MG TABLET are stomach pain, loss of appetite, indigestion/heartburn, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

name: Salytar WS Ointment 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SALYTAR WS OINTMENT

Salytar WS Ointment is used in the management of skin conditions psoriasis and fungal infections. It contains Coal tar and Salicylic acid as active ingredients which helps in removal of dead skin cells.

Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which increases in diseased conditions) proliferation and slow down the growth of skin cells. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.

Always use Salytar WS Ointment as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash and dry the affected area. Apply the medicine and gently massage until it disappears. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Use it once or twice daily, preferably in the evening. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SALYTAR WS OINTMENT

Salytar WS Ointment may cause skin and or scalp irritation. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this ointment.

introduction:
Introduction About HEXIMAR OINTMENT

HEXIMAR OINTMENT contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. HEXIMAR OINTMENT is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

HEXIMAR OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying HEXIMAR OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

[GBNKEYWORLD] should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women which is advised not to apply on breast area while feeding the baby.

HEXIMAR OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged below 6 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying HEXIMAR OINTMENT are pain at the site of application, burning/stinging sensation, skin irritation, itching, itchy rash, and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Sorifix Ointment 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SORIFIX OINMENT

SORIFIX OINMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

SORIFIX OINMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

SORIFIX OINMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply SORIFIX OINMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using SORIFIX OINMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. SORIFIX OINMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of SORIFIX OINMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.

Uses Of SORIFIX OINMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How SORIFIX OINMENT Works

SORIFIX OINMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.

Apply SORIFIX OINMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: I SALIC 6 Ointment 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About I SALIC 6 OINTMENT

I SALIC 6 OINTMENT is a combination of Halobetasol and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used to manage eczema, psoriasis. This medicine is also used to manage dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis and inflammatory dermatoses.

Eczema is a skin inflammatory disorder characterized by red and itchy rashes. The utmost common cause of eczema is allergies. Psoriasis is an autoimmune disease of the skin that is characterized by red, itchy, and scaly rashes.

I SALIC 6 OINTMENT should not be used on the face, groin, or in axillae. I SALIC 6 OINTMENT is not recommended to use in patients who have rosacea or perioral dermatitis.

I SALIC 6 OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. I SALIC 6 OINTMENT is not recommended to use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effect of this medicine is thinning of skin, dry skin, and application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness). Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsen. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including your eyelids.
usesDetails:
Uses Of I SALIC 6 OINTMENT

It is used to manage:

Eczema
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How I SALIC 6 OINTMENT Works

I SALIC 6 OINTMENT is a combination of Halobetasol and Salicylic acid. Halobetasol is a steroid which works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Salicylic acid works by breaking down keratin clumps, removing dead skin cells, and softening the skin. It also increases the absorption of halobetasol into the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use I SALIC 6 OINTMENT

Apply I SALIC 6 OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of I SALIC 6 OINTMENT to the affected area. Managed areas on the face should not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Your doctor will decide the right dose, and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Salytar WS Ointment 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About SALYTAR WS OINTMENT

Salytar WS Ointment is used in the management of skin conditions psoriasis and fungal infections. It contains Coal tar and Salicylic acid as active ingredients which helps in removal of dead skin cells.

Coal tar works by decreasing the keratinocyte (type of skin cell which increases in diseased conditions) proliferation and slow down the growth of skin cells. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer of the affected scalp region.

Always use Salytar WS Ointment as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash and dry the affected area. Apply the medicine and gently massage until it disappears. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Use it once or twice daily, preferably in the evening. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SALYTAR WS OINTMENT

Salytar WS Ointment may cause skin and or scalp irritation. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this ointment.

I SALIC 3% OINTMENT should not be used on the face, groin, or in axillae. I SALIC 3% OINTMENT is not recommended to use in patients who have rosacea or perioral dermatitis.

I SALIC 3% OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. I SALIC 3% OINTMENT is not recommended to use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effect of this medicine is thinning of skin, dry skin, and application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness). Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsen. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including your eyelids.

How I SALIC 3% OINTMENT Works

I SALIC 3% OINTMENT is a combination of Halobetasol and Salicylic acid. introduction:
Introduction About COSVATE SOR OINMENT

COSVATE SOR OINMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

COSVATE SOR OINMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

COSVATE SOR OINMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply COSVATE SOR OINMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using COSVATE SOR OINMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. COSVATE SOR OINMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of COSVATE SOR OINMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.

Uses Of COSVATE SOR OINMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How COSVATE SOR OINMENT Works

COSVATE SOR OINMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.

introduction:
Introduction About METASONE S OINTMENT

METASONE S OINTMENT is a combination of Mometasone and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dermatological agents. METASONE S OINTMENT is used to manage psoriasis, especially in case of intensive scaling, in adults and adolescents (above 12 years of age).

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes a skin rash with itchy, scaly patches, most commonly on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp which is a common, long-term disease that occurs due to triggering factors such as infections, cuts, burns and/or certain medications which is generally painful and tends to go through cycles, flaring for a few weeks to months.

Avoid applying METASONE S OINTMENT if you have bacterial infection such as pyoderma (pus-producing skin disease), syphilis (sexually transmited bacterial disease), tuberculosis, viral infections such as herpes simplex, chicken pox, fungal infections such as dermatophyte, yeast and rosacea (type of skin disease) marked by reddens and or other changes of the skin in the facial area.

Before applying METASONE S OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are receiving ultraviolet management and have any other skin problems. METASONE S OINTMENT is not recommended for use during pregnancy and breast-feeding women should consult their doctor before use.

METASONE S OINTMENT is recommended for use in children and adolescents (above 12 years of age). The most common side effects of using METASONE S OINTMENT are weak to moderate burning sensation at the site of application, itching and localized thinning of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How METASONE S OINTMENT Works

METASONE S OINTMENT is used to manage psoriasis, where Mometasone reduces the redness and itchiness of skin by blocking the production of prostaglandin (chemical messenger), which is responsible for causing redness and itchiness of skin and Salicylic acid helps in softening and removing the psoriasis scales by acting as a scale filter which causes shedding of outer layer of the skin thereby providing relief from the symptoms of psoriasis.

Always apply METASONE S OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. It should not be applied under bandages or similar. Avoid applying the medicine around your eyes or mucous membrane. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of using this medicine depending upon severity of the condition.

name: PIGOLYN Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About PIGOLYN CREAM

PIGOLYN CREAM contains Trioxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Photosensitizers. It is used in the management of vitiligo (a pigmentation disorder of the skin that causes loss of skin color in patches) along with ultraviolet (UV) light and to increase the tolerance of the skin from the sunlight.

Trioxsalen works by photosensitization of the skin when exposed to UV or sunlight which is converted to its active metabolite to produce a beneficial reaction affecting the diseased tissue (reduces the abnormal cells and re-pigments the discolored skin).

After photoactivation it creates cross-links in DNA, which can cause programmed cell death. Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using PIGOLYN CREAM inform your doctor if you have had an allergy or disease condition. Consult your doctor for advice.

Safety and effectiveness of PIGOLYN CREAM in pregnant, breastfeeding women and children has not been established yet. Consult your doctor before using.

The most common side effects are erythema (skin redness), blisters on skin, edema (swelling), itching. Consult your doctor or visit a nearby hospital if you experience any unusual symptoms.

PIGOLYN CREAM works by photosensitization of the skin when exposed to UV or sunlight which reduces the abnormal cells and re-pigments the discolored skin. As a result, it manages depigmented skin.

name: PROTAR Ointment 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About PROTAR OINTMENT

PROTAR OINTMENT is a combination of Coal tar, and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines known as Keratolytic agents and Keratoplastics respectively. It is used in the management of skin conditions like psoriasis vulgaris (autoimmune disease characterised by thickened patches of inflamed and red skin covered with silvery scales), scaling dermatoses and neuro dermatitis (skin condition with red and scaly patch), hyper keratotic skin condition, cracked heals, palmoplantar keratoderma (excessive skin thickening of palms and soles), dandruff of skin, scaling, itching and flaking skin.

PROTAR OINTMENT is not recommended for use if you have soreness (painful and itchy) due to psoriasis, or pustular psoriasis which is characterised by small fluid filled blisters, tenderness, and inflammation and if you have infected skin. Consult your doctor before using.

PROTAR OINTMENT should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding woman. Consult your doctor for advice before using. PROTAR OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin and or scalp irritation. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PROTAR OINTMENT

It is used to manage following skin conditions:

Psoriasis vulgaris
Scaling dermatoses
Neuro dermatitis
Hyper keratotic skin condition
Cracked heals
Palmoplantar keratoderma
Dandruff of skin
Scaling, itching, and flaking skin
mechanismOfAction:
How PROTAR OINTMENT Works

PROTAR OINTMENT effectively reduces skin conditions where Coal tar works by the shedding the dead skin cells (keratinocytes which is increased in disease conditions) through inhibition of DNA which is necessary for the cell growth and multiplication. Salicylic acid works by softening the scaly patches and causes shedding of the outer layer by reducing redness and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use PROTAR OINTMENT

Always use PROTAR OINTMENT exactly as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

For Ointment: Wash and dry the affected area. Apply the medicine and gently massage until it disappears. Do not cover the affected region with any dressing unless your doctor informed you. Wash your hands before and after use.

For Soap: Work the soap into a lather and massage the skin and rinse thoroughly.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PROTAR OINTMENT
Common
 Skin or scalp irritation

Stop using PROTAR OINTMENT and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Eruptions like acne
Photosensitivity or sensitivity to sunlight

introduction:
Introduction About SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT

SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

[GBNKEYWORLD] should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women which is advised not to apply on breast area while feeding the baby.

SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged below 6 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SORIFIX SOLO OINTMENT are pain at the site of application, burning/stinging sensation, skin irritation, itching, itchy rash, and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Acrotac 10mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE

ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

name: Acrotac 10mg Capsule 20'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE

ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE contains Acitretin which belongs to a group of medicines called retinoids. It is used to manage severe skin condition in which the skin has become thick and scaly. These skin problems include the psoriasis, ichthyosis and keratosis follicularis (Darier’s disease). It works by improving the normal growth of the skin. In psoriasis the cells in outer layer of the skin grow more faster than normal with red, irritated, inflamed, thicker skin.

Always take ACROTAC 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the medicine whole with plenty of water. It should not be given to children as it may cause changes in bone growth. If it is given to a child, the doctor will decide the correct dose based on the child’s weight.

This medicine is contraindicated in cases of the hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema, urticaria) to acitretin or to other retinoids. Do not drive or operate any machinery while taking this medicine, particularly at night time since your vision may be affected. Do not take this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It can pass into your milk and may harm your baby. The most common side effects include dry mouth, joint pain, tight muscles, hair loss, dry eyes, rise in blood fats.

introduction:
Introduction About SORISTOP OINTMENT

SORISTOP OINTMENT contains Calcipotriol which belongs to group of medicines called Anti-psoriatics. SORISTOP OINTMENT is used to manage plaque psoriasis (long-lasting autoimmune disease that cause thicky scaly patches on skin) in affected individuals.

SORISTOP OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Calcipotriol. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction (immune response to an allergen), calcium metabolism disorders (due to high/low calcium levels), vitamin D toxicity, and/or severe liver & kidney disease.

Before applying SORISTOP OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are a smoker, undergoing ultraviolet management, and/or suffering from exfoliative/pustular psoriasis.

[GBNKEYWORLD] should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women which is advised not to apply on breast area while feeding the baby.

SORISTOP OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged below 6 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SORISTOP OINTMENT are pain at the site of application, burning/stinging sensation, skin irritation, itching, itchy rash, and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Melan Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MELAN TABLET

MELAN TABLET contains Methoxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatics. It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light for the effective management of certain skin diseases like vitiligo and psoriasis.

Psoriasis is a condition in which the skin cells in the body grow too rapidly and form scales and dry patches, mostly on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Vitiligo is a long-term condition in which pale white patches develop on any area of skin (commonly on the face, neck, and hands, and in skin creases) due to the lack of melanin (a skin pigment).

During MELAN TABLET management, your doctor may advise you to wear special wrap-around sunglasses that totally block or absorb ultraviolet light, to avoid exposure of your skin and lips to sunlight for 8 hours after management, to wear protective clothing like hat or gloves to cover as much of your body as possible after management, and to use a sunscreen product having a protection factor of at least 15 (only after management).

MELAN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having aphakia (not having a lens inside the eye), existing or history of melanoma, invasive squamous cell carcinoma, or photosensitivity diseases.

Before taking MELAN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had multiple basal cell carcinoma, previous arsenic, x-ray or Grenz ray therapy, heart, GI or liver diseases, chronic infection, or if you are unable to tolerate prolonged standing or exposure to heat stress.

MELAN TABLET should be taken in pregnancy only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. In young women, it is recommended to use contraception throughout the therapy. Breastfeeding should be avoided while taking MELAN TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking MELAN TABLET are itching, redness of the skin, and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MELAN TABLET

It is used along with controlled ultraviolet light to manage:

Vitiligo
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How MELAN TABLET Works

In psoriasis, MELAN TABLET is assumed to work by damaging the DNA on exposure to light, resulting in decreased cell multiplication, but other mechanisms may also be playing some role. In vitiligo, it has been suggested that melanocytes (cells containing the pigment called melanin) in the hair follicle are stimulated by MELAN TABLET to move up the follicle and to repopulate the outermost layer of your skin.
usageDetails:
How to use MELAN TABLET

Take MELAN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide an appropriate dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET

PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET contains Trioxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatic agents. It is used in the management of vitiligo and psoriasis along with UV light.

Vitiligo is a pigmentation disorder of the skin that causes loss of skin colour in patches. Psoriasis is a skin condition that causes rashes with itchy, scaly spots on the knees, elbows, trunk, and scalp.

Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition. After taking the medicine avoid exposure to the sun even through a window or glass for at least 8 hours.

Before taking PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have or had an allergic reaction to sunlight, porphyria, heart or blood vessel disease, eye problems (cataract), infections, stomach pain, skin cancer or melanoma, and lupus erythematosus.

PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. The safety and effectiveness of this medicine in breastfeeding women have not been established yet.

The safety and effectiveness of PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET in elderly patients had not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET are itching, irritation and nausea. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
usesDetails:
Uses Of PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET
Used to manage vitiligo and psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET Works

PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET works by activating certain skin cells (melanocytes) and helps repigment the discolored, white patches in vitiligo. It also slows down the rapid growth of skin cells in psoriasis. This reduces scaling and thickening of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET

Always take PIGOLYN 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Cover your skin for at least 8 hours by wearing protective clothing, use a sunblock product that has a skin protection factor on your lips and on those areas of your body that cannot be covered. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About SLC SCALP SHAMPOO

SLC Scalp Shampoo is specially designed for smooth and shiny hair which provides relief from itching, scaling, dryness and flaking. It contains salicylic acid, coal tar and zinc pyrithione as active ingredients to promote scalp health and proper hair maintenance.

Coal tar contains anti-inflammatory properties which helps to reduce redness, itching and inflammation of the scalp. It also helps to remove scales and dead skin cells in the scalp.         

Salicylic acid exfoliates the skin by penetrating and breaking down dead skin cells, promoting a cleaner scalp. It soothes scalp irritation while its keratolytic action aids in the removal of scales. Zinc pyrithione contains antimicrobial agent which helps to regulate the sebum production, manage dandruff, seborrhoeic dermatitis, erythema and promote overall scalp health.   

Always use SLC Scalp Shampoo as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. For usage, massage onto wet hair with SLC Scalp shampoo and leave on for few minutes. Reapply allowing lather to remain on hair upto 5 minutes and then rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth and mucous membranes. If contact occurs, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. If irritation occurs, discontinue the use and consult your physician.

name: Soristop C Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About SORISTOP C OINMENT

SORISTOP C OINMENT is a combination of Calcipotriol and Clobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the topical management of plaque psoriasis. Plaque psoriasis (psoriasis vulgaris) is an autoimmune disease that causes cells to reproduce very quickly which causes thick, scaly patches called plaques on the skin.

SORISTOP C OINMENT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, skin atrophy, viral infections such as chicken pox or measles, skin infections and other skin diseases.

SORISTOP C OINMENT is intended for external use only. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Do not apply SORISTOP C OINMENT on the face.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor before using SORISTOP C OINMENT. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

There is no clinical trial experience in children. Children may demonstrate greater susceptibility to systemic steroid related adverse effects due to a larger skin surface area to body weight ratio as compared to adults. Consult your doctor before using. SORISTOP C OINMENT should be used with caution in elder patients. The most common side effects of SORISTOP C OINMENT are skin irritation and mild aggravation of the disease. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SORISTOP C OINMENT
Used to manage plaque psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How SORISTOP C OINMENT Works

SORISTOP C OINMENT works by managing psoriasis and its effects on the skin. Calcipotriol works by blocking the formation of new cells and manages accumulation of these cells. It plays a major role in managing psoriasis and helps body’s immunity to alter the cause of disease. Clobetasol belongs to corticosteroid helps in reducing inflammation by supressing the mediators responsible for it.
usageDetails:
How to use SORISTOP C OINMENT

Apply SORISTOP C OINMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET

NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET contains Trioxsalen which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsoriatic agents. It is used in the management of vitiligo and psoriasis along with UV light.

Vitiligo is a pigmentation disorder of the skin that causes loss of skin colour in patches. Psoriasis is a skin condition that causes rashes with itchy, scaly spots on the knees, elbows, trunk, and scalp.

Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition. After taking the medicine avoid exposure to the sun even through a window or glass for at least 8 hours.

Before taking NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have or had an allergic reaction to sunlight, porphyria, heart or blood vessel disease, eye problems (cataract), infections, stomach pain, skin cancer or melanoma, and lupus erythematosus.

NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. The safety and effectiveness of this medicine in breastfeeding women have not been established yet.

The safety and effectiveness of NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET in elderly patients had not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET are itching, irritation and nausea. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET works by activating certain skin cells (melanocytes) and helps repigment the discolored, white patches in vitiligo. It also slows down the rapid growth of skin cells in psoriasis. This reduces scaling and thickening of the skin.

Always take NEOSOL FORTE 25MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on your age, body weight and health condition.
